headline: Phoenix harvest opens Sunday — work Saturday morning.
weather_notes: Run both zones Saturday morning if Friday night stays dry — soil will be 2 days post-irrigation at 96°F, crossing the 1-day heat re-water threshold.
Do all outdoor work Saturday before 11 AM — Heat Advisory expires 7 AM Saturday, opening the week's first comfortable outdoor window.
Pull w4 onions Saturday morning — 30% afternoon storm chance risks saturating bulbs in ground and complicating curing.
Check e1 Phoenix for color Saturday morning — harvest window opens Aug 24 and this week's 100–101°F may have pushed fruit ahead of schedule.

surfaced_tasks.title: Tip new blackberry primocanes if 3–4 ft tall
surfaced_tasks.reason: 42 days overdue — Saturday morning after the Heat Advisory expires at 7 AM is the week's first comfortable outdoor cane work window.

suggested_tasks.title: Pull w4 onions — 118 days, past maturity
suggested_tasks.description: Super Star and Yellow Sweet Spanish at 118 days are deep past their maturity window — pull Saturday morning before afternoon storm risk saturates soil and complicates curing.

suggested_tasks.title: Dig potato bags — 14 days past harvest window
suggested_tasks.description: Yukon Gold at 94 days is 14 past the 80-day outer window — dig Saturday morning while the Heat Advisory is lifted and conditions are most workable.

suggested_tasks.title: Check e1 Phoenix tomatoes for first fruit
suggested_tasks.description: Harvest window opens Aug 24 — inspect Sunday for any fruit showing color, as sustained 101°F this week may have pushed ripening ahead of schedule.
